note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). type=python checks are computable via genie_history.py; type=manual require historian/editor review.

gates.text: Title confirmed and trademark-screened against active widely-recognized history titles in the subject space
One of three subtitle options selected and approved; no hyperbole without exceptional justification
Primary (and optional secondary) sub-niche code locked in the Intake Report
Period scope and geographic scope defined and recorded
Audience calibration and tone register confirmed; polemic only on explicit user instruction with disclosure
Contested Status flag set YES/NO; if YES the contested-event protocol is active throughout
Quotation Volume classified LOW (<5) / MEDIUM (5-20) / HIGH (>20); HIGH activates per-chapter authentication
Primary Source Access confirmed; YES activates Hybrid Research mode
Image policy confirmed (included/excluded, type, count per chapter)
Page target set against a comparable sub-niche page band
All expert-panel roles activated (4, plus Quotation Authentication Specialist when quotations appear)
Architecture A/B/C selected and locked; does not change mid-manuscript
Intake Report output produced and user-confirmed before Phase I
Table of Contents complete with all chapters, front matter, and back matter
Chapter titles reflect period/theme scope, not generic (include date ranges or thematic pillars)
Chapter count within the locked architecture's bounds (A 8-16, C 10-18; B per SKILL)
Per-chapter page allocation reviewed against the page target
Image/map placement markers embedded in the TOC (List of Maps/Figures if images included)
Notes and bibliography citation style confirmed (Chicago, APA, or other)
Chronological architecture: dates and sequence verified for internal consistency before writing
Contested chapters identified and flagged in the outline; quotation plan queued for authentication
Opening hook is specific and engaging, not 'In this chapter we will...'
Historical Context Block present
At least one direct primary-source engagement per chapter (or explicit secondary-source citation)
All direct quotations authenticated to a primary/high-confidence source or explicitly caveated
Contested material handled per protocol: name the contest, steel-man positions, cite the tradition, do not resolve what scholarship has not
Presentism Guard applied: moral assessments contextualized and framed as interpretation, not fact
Chronology audit: dates consistent with adjacent chapters and the historical record; no anachronisms
Regional/subaltern perspective reviewed; absent voices identified and integrated where the subject demands
Chapter ends with interpretive synthesis (not a list summary) and a bridge transition to the next chapter
Word count within the architecture/audience target range
No factual claim made without a citable basis (endnote or in-text attribution)

Sub-niche Gate-3 additions applied: HIST-MIL order-of-battle/geography/command/period tactics; HIST-POL vote counts/legal citations/non-partisan framing; HIST-BIO dates/anecdote sourcing/interpretation-framing/no hagiography; HIST-ORL consent/community review/indigenous framing
All chapters complete and Gate 3 passed
Chronology audit conducted across full manuscript; dates internally consistent
Quotation master list: all direct quotations authenticated or appropriately caveated
All contested topics handled per protocol; no false consensus presented as settled
Bibliography complete with primary/secondary/archival sections and at least the minimum source count for the page length
Endnotes/footnotes complete and correctly formatted in the confirmed style
Glossary complete when the book introduces 10+ specialized/foreign/technical terms
All images/maps have captions and rights confirmed
Mandatory History Disclaimer language present and correct on the copyright page
All expert-panel reviews complete; all Critical and Important issues resolved
Front matter and back matter complete and in correct order
Word count matches the page target's word-count band
KDP metadata prepared: description, seven keywords (each < 50 chars), and categories
